latest_release.name: Rust 1.100.0
latest_release.body: ## Language - [Stabilize never type](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/155499) - [Lint against repeated `#[repr(..)]` attributes](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/157036) - [Stabilize `extern "custom"`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158504) - [Extend `dropping_references`, `dropping_copy_types` and `undropped_manually_drops` lints to `drop_in_place`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160229) - [`unfulfilled_lint_expectations` no longer fires on `#[expect(dead_code)]` inside code that is covered by a dead parent's diagnostic](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161005) - [Turn the error for `repr(align)` fields in a `repr(packed)` type into a deny-by-default lint `aligned_fields_in_packed`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/162160) - [volatile: allow accesses to non-AM memory to trap](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160564/) ## Compiler - [Stabilize `-Cprofile-sample-use`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/155942) - [Enable next solver by default in orphanck](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/160668) ## Platform Support - [`i686-pc-windows-gnu` is now a tier 2 without host tools target](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161681) - [Promote `wasm32-wasip3` to Tier 2](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161940) - [Add new Tier 3 target `powerpc64-sony-ps3`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/162072) Refer to Rust's [platform support page](https://doc.rust-lang.org/rustc/platform-support.html) for more information on Rust's tiered platform support. ## Libraries - [Stabilize custom allocators](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/156882) - [Map `ENOTSUP` to `ErrorKind::Unsupported`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/158580) - [Fix soundness issues in `std::sys::pal::sgx::waitqueue::unsafe_list`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/161334) ## Stabilized APIs - [`impl PartialEq> for Vec`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/vec/struct.Vec.html#impl-PartialEq%3CCow%3C'_,+%5BU%5D%3E%3E-for-Vec%3CT,+A%3E) - [`impl PartialEq> for &[T]`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/primitive.slice.html#impl-PartialEq%3CCow%3C'_,+%5BU%5D%3E%3E-for-%26%5BT%5D) - [`impl PartialEq> for &mut [T]`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/primitive.slice.html#impl-PartialEq%3CCow%3C'_,+%5BU%5D%3E%3E-for-%26mut+%5BT%5D) - [`std::alloc::Allocator`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/alloc/trait.Allocator.html) - [`std::alloc::Global`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/alloc/struct.Global.html) - [`std::alloc::System`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/alloc/struct.System.html) - [`impl Allocator for Global`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/alloc/trait.Allocator.html#impl-Allocator-for-Global) - [`impl Allocator for System`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/alloc/trait.Allocator.html#impl-Allocator-for-System) - [`impl Allocator for &A`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/alloc/trait.Allocator.html#impl-Allocator-for-%26A) - [`impl Allocator for Box`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/alloc/trait.Allocator.html#impl-Allocator-for-Box%3CT,+A%3E) - [`impl Allocator for &mut A`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/alloc/trait.Allocator.html#impl-Allocator-for-%26mut+A) - [`impl Allocator for Arc`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/alloc/trait.Allocator.html#impl-Allocator-for-Arc%3CT,+A%3E) - [`impl Allocator for Rc`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/alloc/trait.Allocator.html#impl-Allocator-for-Rc%3CT,+A%3E) - [Website][Rust] | [Getting started] | [Learn] | [Documentation] | [Contributing]
This is the main source code repository for [Rust]. It contains the compiler, standard library, and documentation. [Rust]: https://www.rust-lang.org/ [Getting Started]: https://www.rust-lang.org/learn/get-started [Learn]: https://www.rust-lang.org/learn [Documentation]: https://www.rust-lang.org/learn#learn-use [Contributing]: CONTRIBUTING.md ## Why Rust? - **Performance:** Fast and memory-efficient, suitable for critical services, embedded devices, and easily integrated with other languages. - **Reliability:** Our rich type system and ownership model ensure memory and thread safety, reducing bugs at compile-time. - **Productivity:** Comprehensive documentation, a compiler committed to providing great diagnostics, and advanced tooling including package manager and build tool ([Cargo]), auto-formatter ([rustfmt]), linter ([Clippy]) and editor support ([rust-analyzer]). [Cargo]: https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo [rustfmt]: https://github.com/rust-lang/rustfmt [Clippy]: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-clippy [rust-analyzer]: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer ## Quick Start Read ["Installation"] from [The Book]. ["Installation"]: https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch01-01-installation.html [The Book]: https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/index.html ## Installing from Source If you really want to install from source (though this is not recommended), see [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md). ## Getting Help See https://www.rust-lang.org/community for a list of chat platforms and forums. ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
